summary: Bench card created out of a Klein 9B research conversation. Three legs (base vs base+turbo LoRA; base+turbo vs distilled; 9b-kv vs the leg-B winner) across four fixed stress scenarios - object/character replacement, clothing replacement, localised edit seam+lighting integrity, pose change - 3 seeds each. Leg 0 is blocking: every 9B variant is ~29GB bf16 and this card is a 16380 MiB 4060 Ti, so the shippable format (fp8/GGUF/nvfp4) must be settled before any leg runs. Blocks MPI-598.

Leg 0 reshaped after research: INT8 ConvRot EXISTS for base (9.41GB), distilled (9.43GB) and KV (9.43GB) plus the Qwen3 encoder (9.44GB) - same quantisation family as the shipped 4B weight, reported ~2x fp8 on consumer Ada. So Leg 0 is INT8-vs-fp8, not 'find something that fits'; bf16 dropped from the bench entirely. Open risk logged: INT8 may need BobJohnson24/ComfyUI-INT8-Fast, though node_lock pins no INT8 node and the 4B int8 weight runs regardless - a shipping constraint for MPI-598 if true. Turbo LoRA confirmed Civitai-community by Fabio (downloaded during the 4B work, since deleted); HF mirror vafipas663 noted as the no-VPN route. Outputs pinned to D:\WORK\Images\Outputs\klein_9b per arm. CLIP+VAE must be held constant - the ComfyUI templates name two different VAEs.

Leg 0 largely pre-solved. INT8 custom-node question CLOSED with no bench run: six int8_convrot weights already run in production and node_lock pins zero INT8 nodes, so core ComfyUI is native - the ComfyUI-INT8-Fast writeups predate core support. INT8 is now the decided format, not a candidate. Weights pulled (39.1GB of 81.1GB free): 9b, 9b-kv, base-9b, qwen3-8b, all int8_convrot. Qwen3-8B was NOT already on disk - what we had is qwen_3_4b, Klein 4B's encoder, a different model that cannot be promoted. Turbo LoRA SOURCED WITHOUT CIVITAI OR VPN from anyMODE's own HF repo, sha256 matching CivArchive exactly. Its construction (Klein-distilled minus Klein-base, LoRA-decomposed) reshapes legs A and B: strength is a continuous base-to-distilled dial, so turboToggle may want to be a slider, and 'base+turbo@1.0 = distilled' is the premise rather than a finding.

Bench workflow built from the shipped Klein 4B template per Fabio: research/klein_9b_bench.json + research/README.md (per-arm settings table, node ids, traps). Input_is_Turbo drives numbers only - no turbo-LoRA loader exists in the graph, but Input_Lora_1 (node 99) is a free slot in the model chain so no surgery is needed. Trap found and fixed in the copy: node 38's 4B NSFW LoRA is UNCONDITIONAL in the model chain and loads even at strength 0, so it would have applied a 4B LoRA to a 9B model on every run; bypassed, and the eight 4B style LoRAs cleared. No Qwen3-8B dep exists - qwen3-4b-clip is a different size and boogu-qwen3vl-8b-clip is a vision-language model at type 'boogu', so MPI-598 owes a new ~9.4GB dep. KV weight identity RESOLVED by measurement: same size, different sha256, so KV is a real variant and leg C's parity check is load-bearing.
